status: pre-registered before the 20-seed confirmatory run; the 3-seed run was an implementation smoke test

controlled_signal.precision_assignment: half 0.9, half 0.5; deterministic from seed and case_id; independent of query features a pre-hoc router can see

primary_metric: top-1 accuracy at cost budget 1.0 on the controlled MA subset

positive_criterion.ci: 95% CI of the paired difference across seeds excludes 0
positive_criterion.frontier: planner_preliminary top-1 accuracy >= planner_no_evidence at every budget in the grid

real_data_control.setting: same cases with no preliminary signal
real_data_control.rule: if the real-data control is not positive, no real-data method claim; the controlled result is mechanism evidence only

caveat: The preliminary signal is synthetic. The primary result is a controlled mechanism result, not real financial evidence.
